design_notes: Use serif throughout; single accent colour (e.g. #003366).
Financials table: hairline rules, right-aligned numbers, left-aligned period column.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three boxes, growth bars proportional to value, split bar with percentage labels.
Pull quote: larger serif italic, centred, with a thin rule above and below.
Sidebar: light grey background, no border, compact type.
